name: TV DIABLO Windows
note: v1926: Two surfaces disagreeing about one number, and two chronicles wearing different greens. The repair fixed the F-Sets count and repainted the two SET surfaces, but the console DAILY TASK FORCE reads a cached bridge that is only rewritten inside forgeScan, reached through renderForge - so the tab went live while the bridge stayed a fossil. Reproduced exactly: bridge 118, tab 116, on the same page. v1862 taught that cache comparator about the set count; this makes sure the comparator is actually consulted after the count moves, because a repair that fixes one of two surfaces has not fixed the disagreement, it has moved it. And the meters: the stylesheet already unifies all three sibling tabs with one fp-fill gradient, and F-Uniques used it by passing no colour, while F-Sets passed one inline - and inline beats the stylesheet, so the one tab opted itself out of the rule written to keep them the same. Measured before: uniques 95,201,122 and sets 74,222,128. v775 had already noticed the sibling drift, unified the TITLE colour, wrote was 4ade80 on Sets in its own comment, and left the FILL behind. Both meters now inherit one rule and their computed styles are byte-identical. Also rewrote the Chronicle bar reader, which had been returning a single constant across three different reels and read 83.9 percent on a page printing 63.
